library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(magrittr)
library(tibble)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 5.1. Ready data for LASSO Workflow


# Import data
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1, check.names=F
)


# Prepare inputs for LASSO
X <- as.matrix(protein_mat)
y <- metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"






# 5.2. LASSO Workflow


# Function for a single outer CV fold
lasso_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold) {
  set.seed(project_seed + test_fold)
  
  train <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold != test_fold
  
  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ],
    y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
  )
  
  
  
  
  
  
# 5.2a. Select lambda based on LASSO CV
  
  
  # Perform cross validated LASSO to pick optimal lambda
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X[train, ],
    y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = nfolds
  )
  
  # Predictions on test fold
  preds <- predict(
    fit,
    X[!train, ],
    type = "response",
    s = cv_fit$lambda.1se
  )[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")
  
  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(
    fit,
    s = cv_fit$lambda.1se
  )[-1, 1]
  
  # Keep nonzero coefficients only
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
  
  
  
  
  
  
# 5.2b. Build data frame
  
  
  nonzero <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold = test_fold
  )
  
  list(
    pred = preds,
    mod = fit,
    coef = nonzero
  )
}






# 5.3. Run LASSO on all folds


lasso_results <- lapply(
  1:max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold),
  lasso_cv_outer_fold
)

lasso_preds <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  row.names=F
)

stopifnot(
  all(lasso_fold_coefs$protein %in% protein_lookup_table$SYMBOL),
  all(rownames(X) == metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name)
)






# 5.4. LASSO with fixed protein count per fold


lasso_cv_fixed_n <- function(test_fold, target_n) {
  set.seed(project_seed + test_fold)
  
  train <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold != test_fold
  
  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ],
    y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
  )
  
  # Count nonzero coefficients at each lambda
  nz <- apply(
    fit$beta,
    2,
    function(b) sum(b != 0)
  )
  
  # Find lambda that selects exactly target_n proteins
  if (any(nz == target_n)) {
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which(nz == target_n)[1]]
  } else {
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which.min(abs(nz - target_n))]
  }
  
  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(
    fit,
    s = lambda_target
  )[-1, 1]
  
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
  
  # Trim to top target_n by absolute value
  if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
    nonzero <- nonzero[
      order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]
    ]
  }
  
  # Adjust lambda until target_n reached
  if (length(nonzero) < target_n) {
    lam_idx <- which.min(
      abs(fit$lambda - lambda_target)
    )
    
    while (
      length(nonzero) < target_n &&
      lam_idx < length(fit$lambda)
    ) {
      lam_idx <- lam_idx + 1
      
      coefs_vec <- coef(
        fit,
        s = fit$lambda[lam_idx]
      )[-1, 1]
      
      nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
    }
    
    if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
      nonzero <- nonzero[
        order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]
      ]
    }
  }
  
  stopifnot(length(nonzero) == target_n)
  
  preds <- predict(
    fit,
    X[!train, ],
    type="response",
    s = lambda_target
  )[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")
  
  nonzero_df <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold = test_fold
  )
  
  list(
    pred = preds,
    mod = fit,
    coef = nonzero_df
  )
}






# 5.5. Run fixed-n LASSO for n=1 and n=3


# 1 target classifier
lasso_results_n1 <- lapply(
  1:max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold),
  function(f) lasso_cv_fixed_n(
    f,
    target_n = 1
  )
)

lasso_preds_n1 <- lasso_results_n1 %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- lasso_results_n1 %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"),
  row.names=F
)

stopifnot(
  all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$fold) == 1)
)


# 3 target LASSO
lasso_results_n3 <- lapply(
  1:max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold),
  function(f) lasso_cv_fixed_n(
    f,
    target_n = 3
  )
)

lasso_preds_n3 <- lasso_results_n3 %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- lasso_results_n3 %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n3,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n3,
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n3.csv"),
  row.names=F
)

stopifnot(
  all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n3$fold) == 3)
)
